rationale: The file contains multiple transaction entrypoints (Invoke dispatcher and public methods like EndorserTransaction, CertificateHolderTransaction, LendingTransaction, ReturnInstallment) that write to the ledger. Multiple instances of `time.Now()` are used to populate `TransactionTime` fields in structs (MoneyTransaction, TransactionTracker, LendingTracker) that are subsequently marshaled and written to state via `APIstub.PutState()`. Since `time.Now()` returns non-deterministic wall-clock time and directly influences the ledger state written by endorsers, this constitutes a C1 TIME_NOW vulnerability that will cause consensus divergence across endorsing peers.
